class.name: RailVehicleElectricEngine
class.brief_description: Electric engine handler class. Used to check/set it's parameters

method.name: converter_fuse_reset
method.description: The converter's overload relay reset ([code]RelayReset(primaryconverteroverload)[/code]; [code]OnCommand_converteroverloadrelayreset[/code], [code]Train.cpp:3567-3585[/code]).

method.name: fuse_reset
method.description: The overload relay reset - "zbij nadmiarowy" ([code]FuseOn()[/code]).

method.name: get_camshaft_available
method.description: Whether the engine is started by a camshaft ([code]HasCamshaft[/code]).

method.name: get_circuit_imax
method.description: The overload relay's current threshold in use [lb]A[rb] ([code]Imax[/code]).

method.name: get_contactors_active
method.description: The cab's line contactors lamp: lit while the contactors are open and the brakes released ([code]Train.cpp:9054-9058[/code]).

method.name: get_converter_overload
method.description: Whether the converter's overload relay has tripped ([code]ConvOvldFlag[/code]).

method.name: get_diff_relay_active
method.description: The cab's differential (ground) relay lamp: lit while the ground relay is open and the brakes released ([code]Train.cpp:9054-9058[/code]).

method.name: get_dynamic_brake_active
method.description: Whether the dynamic brake works ([code]DynamicBrakeFlag[/code]).

method.name: get_engine_voltage
method.description: The voltage on the motors [lb]V[rb] ([code]EngineVoltage[/code]).

method.name: get_fuse_active
method.description: Whether the overload relay has tripped ([code]FuseFlag[/code]).

method.name: get_highcurrent_active
method.description: The cab's high current lamp: the overload relay at its high threshold ([code]Imax[/code] at [code]ImaxHi[/code]).

method.name: get_line_breaker_closes_at_no_power
method.description: Whether the line breaker closes only with the master controller at a position without power ([code]LineBreakerClosesOnlyAtNoPowerPos[/code]).

method.name: get_line_breaker_delay
method.description: How long the line breaker takes to close [s] ([code]CtrlDelay[/code]).

method.name: get_line_breaker_initial_delay
method.description: How long the line breaker takes to close the first time [s] ([code]InitialCtrlDelay[/code]).

method.name: get_mainbreaker_active
method.description: Whether the main breaker is closed ([code]Mains[/code]).

method.name: get_motor_connectors_open
method.description: Whether the traction motors' line contactors are held open ([code]StLinSwitchOff[/code]).

method.name: get_motor_current
method.description: The traction motors' current [lb]A[rb] ([code]Im[/code]).

method.name: get_resistors_active
method.description: The cab's starting resistors lamp: lit while the line contactors are closed and current goes through the resistors ([code]ResistorsFlagCheck()[/code]).

method.name: get_total_current
method.description: The current drawn from the high voltage line [lb]A[rb] ([code]Itot[/code]).

method.name: get_vent_overload_active
method.description: The cab's resistor fan lamp: lit while current goes through the resistors and their fan hardly turns ([code]RventRot[/code], [code]Train.cpp:9076[/code]).

method.name: is_line_contactor_closed
method.description: Whether the line contactors are closed ([code]StLinFlag[/code]).

method.name: is_pressure_switch_tripped
method.description: Whether the control pressure switch has tripped ([code]ControlPressureSwitch[/code]).

method.name: set_motor_connectors_open
method.description: The traction motors' line contactors held open, or let go ([code]StLinSwitchOff[/code]).

members.member: [code]Circuit:ImaxHi[/code] Maximum current on "high" starting stage, in amperes.
[code]Circuit:ImaxLo[/code] Maximum current on "low" starting stage, in amperes.
[code]Circuit:IminHi[/code] Automatic starting relay switching current on the "high" stage; also used by the AI driver.
[code]Circuit:IminLo[/code] Automatic starting relay switching current on the "low" stage; also used by the AI driver.
[code]Circuit:CircuitRes[/code] Motor and circuit resistance, in ohms.
[code]Circuit:TUHEX_Diff[/code] Hysteresis of the ED braking regulator.
[code]Circuit:TUHEX_MaxIw[/code] Maximum excitation current during ED braking (limits max braking force).
[code]Circuit:TUHEX_MinIw[/code] Minimum excitation current during ED braking, resulting from the traction motor's magnetization curve.

[code]Circuit:TUHEX_Stages[/code] Number of distinct ED braking stages. When greater than 0, [member circuit_tuhex_sum_1], [member circuit_tuhex_sum_2] and [member circuit_tuhex_sum_3] should also be set.
[code]Circuit:TUHEX_Sum[/code] Current ED braking regulator setpoint (sum of excitation and rotor currents).
